# 6984 • Vietnam AI Hub

**Canonical ID:** 6984  
**Entity Name:** Vietnam AI Hub  
**Entity Type:** Country AI Hub  
**Parent Hub:** 698 • AI Country Group +8  
**Registry:** CFP+ Global AI Registry  
**Lifecycle Status:** Review Candidate  
**Runtime Status:** Active / Public Registry Node  
**Visibility:** Public  

## 0. Canonical Identity

6984 is the unique CFP+ registry identifier assigned to the Vietnam AI Hub, derived from country calling code +84 within the CFP+ AI Country Hub architecture.

## 1. Canonical Link

https://github.com/charityfundplus/CFP.plus/blob/main/registry/6984.md

## 2. Purpose

This hub provides one stable public parent identity for AI developers, organizations, systems, and integration nodes associated with Vietnam.

## 3. Child Allocation

Child records use the range 69840–69849 for the first allocation set.

## 4. Registry Rules

- One Canonical ID = One Entity
- One Canonical ID = One Direct Link
- Child IDs must reference Parent Hub 6984
- Canonical IDs must not be reassigned
- Material identity changes require Human Governance review

## 5. Governance Authority

**Authority:** CFP+ Human Governance  
**Source of Truth:** CFP+ Canonical Registry  
**Publication Repository:** charityfundplus/CFP.plus

## 6. Verification Status

The hub is publicly active as a Review Candidate. Canonical Locked status requires independent review and Human Governance approval.

## 7. Change Control

All revisions must preserve Canonical ID 6984 and maintain traceable GitHub commit history.
